item.title: Malibu sues state, LA city, county over Palisades fire
item.description: The lawsuit contends that the Palisades fire — which erupted Jan. 7, 2025, in what investigators contend was a flare-up of a blaze known as the Lachman fire that began a week earlier — killed at least six Malibu residents and destroyed 700 homes and dozens of businesses in the city.

item.title: Why a dose of art may be the cure for a number of society’s ailments
item.description: Dr. Daisy Fancourt's new book 'Art Cure: The Science of How the Arts Save Lives' examines the research behind art as a form of medicine.

item.title: Immigrants, public safety, transparency top topics at Whittier forum
item.description: More than 150 people attended the second candidates’ forum in Whittier’s municipal elections, the first that gathered the 11 hopefuls for the office of mayor and councilmember for District 2 and 4

item.title: Azusa girls soccer reaches semifinals with penalty shootout win over San Gabriel
item.description: The Aztecs erase the bad memories from last year's playoff loss with a dramatic victory over in the Division 7 quarterfinals.

item.title: California’s proposed billionaire tax brings Sen. Bernie Sanders to rally in LA
item.description: The progressive senator's decision to wade into the debate signals how the tax proposal is figuring into national conversations about wealth and government services.

item.title: USC men have no answer for No. 10 Illinois in their most lopsided loss of season
item.description: The Fighting Illini open a 22-point lead by halftime and pour it on in the second half to hand the Trojans a 101-65 defeat at the Galen Center. Ezra Ausar has 15 points and 11 rebounds to pace USC.

item.title: La Salle girls basketball grinds out win over Villa Park to reach D1 semifinals
item.description: The Lancers will be on the road in the semifinals against Moreno Valley on Saturday night

item.title: Keppel’s comeback falls short against Leuzinger in girls basketball quarterfinals
item.description: Keppel isn't able to overcome a disastrous start that resulted in it falling behind 17-0 against Leuzinger.

item.title: Warren girls basketball uses team effort to beat Santa Fe in quarterfinals
item.description: Warren comes out on top in the back-and-forth playoff game by taking the lead for good on a layup by Aliyah Lopez in the final two minutes.
